title: Reject an all-frequency measurement claim from finite-band control alone
statement: For a leaking observation filter, use delta_Sigma<=2T*Delta*A_in+integral_outside ||F(omega)||^2 E_out(omega)domega/(2pi), with an ACTUALLY warranted E_out, or A_out=0. The accepted Gaussian measurement calculation then uses the actual positive covariance floor and relative error<1. A passive damped RLC resonance outside the band defeats an unqualified extrapolation; finite calibration points do not eliminate it.
